claim_text: The 9-protein set {osr1, pax2a, lhx1a, wt1a (Window 2) + prkci, cdh17, myh9a (Window 3) + mafba, podxl (Window 4)} is sufficient to induce zebrafish pronephros tissue identity. expected_outcome_if_h1: A reconstitution experiment (e.g., mRNA injection of the 9 mRNAs into early embryo, or chaperone-tissue delivery of the 9 proteins) produces ectopic pronephric structures with marker confirmation (wt1a+, pax2a+ tubules with lumen and cdh17+ duct). Matches PROJECT_SCOPE §4 success gates Induction + Identity.
expected_outcome_if_h0: Reconstitution with the 9-protein set produces incomplete or absent pronephric induction. The minimal set must be larger (>9) or different. Likely missing factor classes: an additional upstream specifier (wnt2ba, fgf signaling, retinoic acid receptors), an additional polarity scaffold, or a missing transporter (slc20a1a / slc4a4a for PT identity).
